title: Individuals with Disabilities Education Act – IDEA (Giáo dục Trẻ Khuyết tật)

versions.text:
Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) – 20 USC §1400 et seq.
Trẻ khuyết tật (3-21 tuổi) có quyền Free Appropriate Public Education (FAPE). Individualized Education Program (IEP). Least Restrictive Environment (LRE). Due process hearing. §504 of Rehabilitation Act: bảo vệ rộng hơn chống phân biệt.
